title: Multi-turn Conversational AI from Text to Multimodal Interaction: Data, Models, Evaluation, and Open Challenges
abstract: arXiv:2608.17605v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conversational AI is moving beyond isolated text prompts toward sustained, multimodal interaction. In real conversations, users clarify goals, revise requests, interrupt responses, switch topics, and introduce new evidence while expecting systems to preserve context across turns. This makes multi-turn dialogue a distinct challenge requiring systems to maintain and update memory, ground responses across modalities, tools, and external knowledge, and adapt across languages and cultures. This study reviews multi-turn conversational AI across text-only dialogue, AudioLLMs and speech-native systems, multimodal and omni-modal systems, and tool-augmented agents. We organize the literature around datasets and benchmarks, modeling paradigms, training strategies, evaluation setups, and cross-cutting challenges. translated_title: 从文本到多模态交互的多轮对话人工智能：数据、模型、评估与开放挑战
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17605v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：对话人工智能正超越孤立的文本提示，向持续的多模态交互发展。在真实对话中，用户会澄清目标、修改请求、打断回应、切换话题，并引入新证据，同时期望系统在多个轮次中保持上下文。这使得多轮对话成为一个独特的挑战，要求系统维护和更新记忆，跨模态、工具和外部知识进行基础响应，并适应不同语言和文化。本研究综述了多轮对话人工智能，涵盖纯文本对话、音频大语言模型和语音原生系统、多模态和全模态系统，以及工具增强型代理。我们围绕数据集和基准、建模范式、训练策略、评估设置和跨领域挑战来组织文献。我们的分析表明，多模态支持的发展速度快于跨一系列轮次维持连贯交互的能力。
tldr: 本文系统综述了多轮对话AI从文本到多模态交互的进展，指出多模态能力发展快于跨轮次连贯交互维持能力，并总结了数据、模型、评估和开放挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically reviews multi-turn conversational AI from text to multimodal interaction, finding that multimodal support has advanced faster than the ability to sustain coherent cross-turn interaction, and summarizes data, models, evaluation, and open challenges.
